purpose: Define navigation, breadcrumbs and sitemap as deterministic projections of canonical nanoCMS structure and metadata rather than separately maintained duplicate trees.

owns: Navigation, Breadcrumb and Sitemap Projection semantics

topics.name: Navigation, Breadcrumb and Sitemap Projection
topics.purpose: Define navigation, breadcrumbs and sitemap as deterministic projections of canonical nanoCMS structure and metadata rather than separately maintained duplicate trees.

semantics.source_rule: Projections derive from the canonical site tree plus explicit visibility/order metadata.
semantics.duplicate_rule: No independent semantic navigation tree is required.
semantics.breadcrumb_rule: Breadcrumb ancestry follows declared structural/navigation relations.
semantics.visibility_rule: Hidden/non-navigation nodes may remain routable according to explicit metadata.
semantics.order_rule: Navigation order is explicit metadata and does not imply execution/domain order.
semantics.localization_rule: Displayed labels resolve through canonical UI label/localization semantics.
semantics.authority_rule: Omission from navigation is not an authorization mechanism.

invariants.rule: nanoCMS owns canonical web/site structure, routes, navigation and MetaModule placement/bindings; it never becomes owner of the placed MetaModule's semantics.

hard_gates.condition: navigation maintained as unrelated duplicate semantic tree
breadcrumb ancestry guessed from URL string only
hidden nav state treated as access control

references.purpose: All projections derive from canonical structure.

prose.summary: Define navigation, breadcrumbs and sitemap as deterministic projections of canonical nanoCMS structure and metadata rather than separately maintained duplicate trees.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against existing Expose/nanoCMS contracts and whole-tree Contract Format 1.4 validation.
